channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kevin Love | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kevin Love from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Kevin Love
item.description:
Tristan Thompson:

“I got to give a big shout out to Kevin Love. Kevin Love put it together. If you had to look at your bingo card and guess who would put it together back then, you would have said Kevin Love. Kevin Love has been in Miami. He has been taking that leadership role and he has done the group chat. So I am like, shout out to Kevin Love for doing it. He put his mind to it, got his team together, and we all showed up. It was amazing.”

Tristan Thompson on Kevin Love, Jul 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Keyonte George on Kevin Love
item.description:
Utah Jazz On SI: Keyonte George on his relationship with Kevin Love:

“K-Love's been around my GOAT. So, it's been a pleasure just to ask him so many questions.”

Keyonte George on Kevin Love, Apr 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kevin Love
item.description:
Tyronn Lue:

“Moving over six inches on the bench—that’s what people don’t understand. It’s tough. Especially when it happens midway through the season. We had just gone to the Finals. Lost Game 6 without Kevin Love and Kyrie. And now I’m being asked to replace Coach Blatt, who had done a hell of a job. If we didn’t make it back to the Finals—or at least to Game 7—I was going to be viewed as a failure. And that pressure? Man, it was real.”

Tyronn Lue on Kevin Love, Aug 27, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Darius Garland on LeBron James, Kevin Love, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Garland told The Ringer earlier this month.

“We’ve been having doubters forever since we started making the playoffs a couple of years ago. When you think of Cleveland, you only think of LeBron James or Kyrie Irving and Kevin Love. So just to have this group of guys and the depth that we have, … it’s not just one guy or two guys that’s really carrying the load.”

Darius Garland on LeBron James, Kevin Love, Kyrie Irving, Apr 23, 2025. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love
item.description:
“I just can't say enough about K-Love, his leadership, and the appreciation for him adapting and molding into different roles. He's like a shapeshifter for us,”

Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love, Jan 1, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love
item.description:
“Starting the other night [against the Rockets], I thought that was really important for a team that offense rebounds so well, and K-Love really helped out on the glass right away, and set the tone for kind of the physicality for the game. You know, you can play him off the bench. He's been great in those minutes.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love, Jan 1, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Kevin Love
item.description:
As Love was whistled for a foul, Williamson fell to the court and Marshall rushed in to object to the way Williamson was fouled.

“I wasn't tripping about K-Love because he actually protected me on my fall,”

Zion Williamson on Kevin Love, Feb 24, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Nikola Jovic:

“For sure, for sure. I’m sure I’m more ready. More ready mentally and physically. The shot also is going to help me a lot. We have some great players that dominate the paint like Jimmy Butler and Bam Adebayo. If you get a wide open three, they want you to make it. That’s why you have guys like Max Strus and Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, K-Love (Kevin Love) who always are going to make shots and they needed to be great to be where we were last year. It’s something we need and it’s something I’m trying to just think about all the time and be ready and confident. Because when I get it, I know they want me to make it.”

Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, Sep 25, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love:

“I had every intention to play him in Game 1,and everything went a bunch of different ways…He brings that championship level experience… He has a timeliness of his winning plays.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love, Jun 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love
item.description:
Christos Tsaltas:Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love's ankle:

“We will find out. He says he's fine. He's a tough veteran guy”

Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love, May 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @Tsaltas46.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Kevin Love
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“It’s not the same team as last year. Jimmy is still Jimmy and Spo is still Spo, but we’ve got to make sure that we’re aware to everybody else – Kevin Love, some of the new guys that they got.”

Jaylen Brown on Kevin Love, May 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Love
item.description:
When Giannis made it to the NBA, he couldn’t even validate his own feelings in part because he didn’t know how.

“In 2017, 2018, DeMar DeRozan and Kevin Love came out public with what they were dealing with,”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Love, Apr 11, 2023. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love:

“I feel like he’s had half a dozen monster games against us.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love, Feb 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love’s playmaking:

“That’s one of the first things he said to me, ‘I think I can help this team with my passing.’”

Erik Spoelstra on Kevin Love, Feb 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Jarrett Allen on Kevin Love
item.description:
#Cavs Jarrett Allen on whether he knew, when he left Philly the other night, that Kevin Love wanted a buyout:

“I did not. I was told he was going for milk and cigarettes and he just never came back.”

Jarrett Allen on Kevin Love, Feb 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Kevin Love
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Tyler Herro, on the possibility of Kevin Love coming to Miami:

“I'm excited. We'll see. Hopefully he decides to bring bring his shooting down to the 305.”

Tyler Herro on Kevin Love, Feb 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris
item.description:
“Me and Kyrie, we matchin’ up. I’m taking [Bradley Beal] over [JR Smith]. You got [LeBron James] over Trevor Ariza. Kevin Love and Markieff Morris, I’m taking Kevin Love but Markieff Morris can shoot threes and post up. I’m taking [Marcin] Gortat over Tristan Thompson,”

John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Kevin Love
item.description:
#Cavs head coachJ.B. Bickerstaff on his level of concern over Kevin Love's shooting slump:

“It's very small because I know Kevin. I know Kevin is a great, elite shooter and he'll find his way out of it.”

JB Bickerstaff on Kevin Love, Jan 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealDCunningham.

item.title: LeBron James on Kevin Love
item.description:
LeBron James on yamming on Kevin Love tonight:

“I hate that it had to be him, he's my guy, that's my brother. Hope I'm still invited to the wedding... I didn't mean it, K Love. I love you and I take it back. I wish I could take those two points back and still win the game by 9.”

LeBron James on Kevin Love, Mar 22, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: LeBron James on Kevin Love, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland
item.description:
“I think big fella (Allen), that acquisition was amazing for them to make that trade. Obviously Darius Garland is a big-time player. And I think the role that Kevin (Love) is playing right now has kind of uplifted those young guys, seeing a veteran that could sacrifice, a champion that’s won a championship, all the things that he’s done, to come off the bench and play this role. I am not surprised by anything that they’re doing right now.”

LeBron James on Kevin Love, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Feb 19, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Cedi Osman on Kevin Love
item.description:
#CavsCedi Osman on the 19-0 run to start the fourth quarter:

“At one point I was like, 'Yo K-Love I think we're gonna need some oxygen.”

Cedi Osman on Kevin Love, Feb 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @kelseyyrusso.

item.title: Lauri Markkanen on Kevin Love
item.description:
“AndI can’t wait to learn from a player like Kevin Love. Just learn aspects of the game from him and the mentality of the game, how he approaches it. I’m looking forward to that as well.”

Lauri Markkanen on Kevin Love, Aug 28, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Kevin Love
item.description:
Colangelo on Kevin Love:

“I didn’t think Kevin Love was gonna play. I wasn’t even sure he had much left to play. He reached out to us and said he was in shape and said he felt he owed us. And on the basis of that, we’re looking at someone with international experience who at one time was a heck of a rebounder and could still shoot the ball. You know, being like a 12th man on a roster. Well, it didn’t work out. He wasn’t in shape. And he was way behind as it turned out. So you move on. Call it a mistake. Call it giving someone an opportunity. Someone who had equity with us. Guys who play for us get a little plus.”

Jerry Colangelo on Kevin Love, Jul 30, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Koby Altman on Kevin Love
item.description:
The Cavs GM added that they’re the only ones who see Love’s vulnerability.

“He has his moments, but he's ours and he's uniquely Kevin Love,”

Koby Altman on Kevin Love, Jun 8, 2021. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Kevin Love
item.description:
#Cavs JB Bickerstaff on Kevin Love's calf soreness:

“I am no expert. I know it’s bothering him. He's working through this stuff, he went through shootaround today. I feel like he's making progress. We just have to continue to make that progress.”

JB Bickerstaff on Kevin Love, Mar 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Isaac Okoro on Kevin Love
item.description:
#CavsIsaac Okoro on what has surprised him at training camp thus far:

“I didn't think Kevin Love still had bounce. He's still getting up there, still dunking right now. He surprised me with a couple dunks that he had. Caught a put-back dunk one time. That surprised me for sure”

Isaac Okoro on Kevin Love, Dec 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: JJ Redick on Kevin Love
item.description:
“What if that shot against Kevin Love went in? We've seen him make that shot hundreds of times. You're talking about one possession as your evidence that he can't get his own shot (laughter). That's crazy to me.”

JJ Redick on Kevin Love, Jul 27, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Collin Sexton on Kevin Love, JB Bickerstaff
item.description:
“We had 17 games left and I felt like we were going to try to finish strong. Me and Kevin (Love) were talking about this the other day. Feel like it’s very important for us to get these games because we have played just 11 games under Coach J.B. (Bickerstaff), so we’re still trying to understand him and he’s still trying to understand us as the head coach, which is a big difference. I feel like we need these games back. But it’s a hard decision to make during this tough time.”

Collin Sexton on Kevin Love, JB Bickerstaff, Apr 10, 2020. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kevin Love
item.description:
His donation to the FiServ Forum workers:Giannis Antetokounmpo:

“First of all, I tried to follow Kevin Love’s lead. I know that we work with these people every day. My first reaction when the league was suspended was, ‘Are these people going to be able to work? Are these people going to be able to leave their homes? Are these people going to be able to provide for themselves and their families? Because most of these people probably live from check-to-check, so me and my family decided to help as much as we could.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kevin Love, Apr 10, 2020. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Kevin Love
item.description:
Incredible optimism from Andre Drummond on #Cavs despite record:

“It doesn’t faze me because I see a bright future here in Cleveland. The young guys here are really, really good. Just with the addition of myself and Kevin (Love) being healthy, we can do special things here.”

Andre Drummond on Kevin Love, Feb 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @MRidenourABJ.
